description_en: Queries the usage of resource plans, including reserved instances (RIs) and storage capacity units (SCUs)
description_zh: 查询资源包(包含RI、scu)的使用量情况
name: QueryDPUtilizationDetail

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for the filtered query. If this parameter is left empty, the details of all used instances are returned
parameters.help_zh: 筛选查询的实例ID，为空时返回所有的使用的实例明细
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The commodity code, such as ecsRi and scu_bag. If this parameter is specified, the ProdCode parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 商品code，如ecsRi、scu_bag等。如果填写该字段，则prodCode字段不生效
parameters.name: commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deducted instance. If this parameter is left empty, the details of all instances are returned
parameters.help_zh: 被抵扣实例的ID，为空时返回所有实例的明细数据
parameters.name: deducted_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. Format: YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Format: YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The token that specifies the start position of the query. Set this parameter to null for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 查询从LastToken之后开始返回。第一次查询填null，之后的从结果NextToken获取
parameters.name: last_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每次查询条数，默认为20，最大值为300
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the resource plan usage of member accounts in finance trusteeship. Valid values:
true: Included.
false: Not included
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含财务云子账号的资源包用量
true：包含
false：不包含
parameters.name: include_share

parameters.help_en: The product code, such as ecs
parameters.name: prod_code

DeductDate.description_en: The deduction date. Example format: YYYY/M/D HH:mm
DeductDate.description_zh: 抵扣日期，格式示例为 YYYY/M/D HH:mm

DeductFactorTotal.description_en: The total computing power or capacity of the RI or SCU during the specified time period
DeductFactorTotal.description_zh: RI或SCU在该时间段的算力或容量总量

DeductHours.description_en: The deduction coefficient. This parameter is valid only when the CommodityCode parameter is set to ecsRi
DeductHours.description_zh: 抵扣系数。 仅当CommodityCode为ecsRi有效

DeductMeasure.description_en: The original metered amount. This indicates the actual amount of resources used by the user within a specific period, without any rule-based adjustments
DeductMeasure.description_zh: 原始计量量。表示用户在某段时间内实际使用的资源量，未经任何规则调整

DeductQuantity.description_en:
The actual deducted computing power or capacity of the corresponding pay-as-you-go instance.
The actual deducted amount (DeductQuantity) is calculated based on the original metered amount (DeductMeasure) and specific deduction rules.
-
DeductQuantity.description_zh:
实际抵扣对应按量实例的算力或容量。
实际抵扣量（DeductQuantity）是基于原始计量量（DeductMeasure）并结合具体抵扣规则计算得出的。
-

DeductedCommodityCode.description_en: The commodity code of the deducted item

DeductedInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the deducted instance

DeductedProductDetail.description_en: The name of the deducted product
DeductedProductDetail.description_zh: 被抵商品（产品明细）名称

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the reserved instance

InstanceSpec.description_en: The instance type of the deducted instance

Region.description_en: The region in the metering data. This parameter can be empty

ShareUid.description_en:
The UID of the account to which the deducted instance belongs.
Shared deduction: the UID of the account to which the deducted instance belongs.
Non-shared deduction: the same as the Uid field
ShareUid.description_zh:
抵扣实例所属uid
共享抵扣：抵扣实例所属uid
非共享抵扣：等于uid字段

Uid.description_en: The UID of the deducted instance

NextToken.description_en: The token that specifies the start position of the next query. Pass this value to the LastToken parameter in the next request. If this parameter is returned as null, the query is complete
NextToken.description_zh: 下次请求查询开始标识，填充到request的LastToken字段中。如果返回为null，则标识查询结束

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
